title: Work IQ: Context IQ adds agents, skills and content sources to the prompt menu
summary: Hold: the licensing field says entitlement is unpublished even though Microsoft documents the Copilot Chat subscription requirement and the existing agent entitlement and billing rules. The roadmap details and the corrected agent-blocking path and API are supported; the expansion's default, dedicated switch and any separate menu-interaction charge remain undocumented.

claims.claim: Context IQ already exists in Copilot Chat.
claims.quote: Context IQ now allows you to search for and select Microsoft Teams channels when creating prompts in Copilot Chat

claims.claim: The 10 March 2026 release notes document selecting a Teams channel in Context IQ to ground Copilot Chat responses.
claims.quote:
## March 10, 2026
Context IQ now allows you to search for and select Microsoft Teams channels when creating prompts in Copilot Chat, so responses are grounded in a specific channel instead of across all Teams content.

claims.claim: Typing / in Copilot Chat opens the reference selection interaction.
claims.quote: To reference a specific piece of information, type **/** and begin typing the people, file, meeting, or email you wish to link.

claims.claim: The existing licensed reference menu offers people, Microsoft 365 files, meetings and emails.
claims.quote: People, Microsoft 365 files, meetings, and emails are accessible through tabs.

claims.claim: The existing reference menu supports Teams chats and channels.
claims.quote: Copilot suggests your relevant Teams group and meeting chats ... under the **Chats** tab. Copilot also displays your recently used Teams channels under the **Channels** tab.

claims.claim: The support article documents referencing SharePoint sites and lists.
claims.quote: Copilot displays SharePoint sites, pages, and lists that you've recently interacted with or were shared with you. Select a site to scope your prompt to its contents.

claims.claim: The existing references menu supports enabled Copilot connector content.
claims.quote: You can now ground your Copilot prompts on third-party data using your organization's Graph Connector content, accessible from the references menu in Copilot Chat.

claims.claim: The cited Context IQ support article does not list agents or skills as reference types.
claims.quote: Searched: agents and skills in the complete Context IQ support article. Read its licensed/unlicensed instructions and all reference-type sections; it lists people, meetings, Teams content, emails, files/images, SharePoint and connectors, not agents or skills.

claims.claim: Reference suggestions are based on scanning the user's files, emails, conversations and other Microsoft 365 services.
claims.quote: When you initiate the references menu, relevant content is suggested based on scanning of your files, emails, conversations, and other Microsoft 365 apps and services.

claims.claim: Copilot refers to user-included content as part of its response.
claims.quote: Copilot refers to the content you include as part of its response.

claims.claim: The Work IQ overview describes user-scoped requests restricted to what the user may see or do.
claims.quote: Actions are user scoped, meaning every request runs in the context of a specific user and only accesses what that user is allowed to see or do.

claims.claim: The Work IQ overview states that every tool invocation is logged and evaluated.
claims.quote: Every tool invocation is logged and evaluated, enabling auditability, usage analytics, rate limiting, and real-time compliance enforcement across agents and data sources.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because entitlement to this Copilot Chat change is not yet published.
claims.quote: Declarative agents that are grounded in instructions and public websites are included with Copilot Chat (Basic), and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) and (Premium).
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to mixed. Replace the blanket unpublished-entitlement wording with: 'Copilot Chat requires an eligible Microsoft 365 subscription. Declarative agents grounded in instructions and public websites are included with Copilot Chat (Basic) and Microsoft 365 Copilot (Basic) and (Premium); agents accessing shared tenant data are metered for the Basic licences. Microsoft has not specified which new Context IQ choices each licence will show or published a separate charge for the menu interaction.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/microsoft-copilot-requirements and the existing https://learn.microsoft.com/copilot/manage/manage-agents-copilot-chat. The standard requires known product entitlement rather than unknown for a new option inside that product.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance; rendered controls table
claims.claim: An administrator reaches agent blocking through Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block.
claims.quote:
Select **Agents** > **All agents**.
In the **All agents** page, select an agent from the list of agents.
In the agent details pane that opens, immediately under the agent's name, select **Block** or **Unblock**.
